LISTEN & MAKE SENSE

Start with your people.

We talk about your team’s needs, questions, and everyday work. Together, we decide where a change would help and whether AI or software has a useful role.

LEARN & PUT INTO PRACTICE

Build confidence together.

Personal guidance and hands-on workshops give people room to try, ask questions, and learn. We introduce AI with sensible data use, clear responsibilities, and human oversight.

CREATE & STAY ALONGSIDE

Make everyday work easier.

When your team needs something of its own, I build software and automations around the way you work—and support the people putting them into practice.

02 / A PERSON YOU CAN WORK WITH

Hi, I’m Raphael.
I’ll work
alongside you.

You know your people.
We find a way forward together.

I work with social initiatives and the people who keep them going. I listen to what matters in your day-to-day work: what takes time, what feels uncertain, and what you’d like to make possible.

Then we work on it together. That might mean a conversation, a practical workshop, help introducing AI responsibly, or software built around your team’s needs.

I’m personally involved, from the first questions to putting things into practice. The aim is for people to feel supported, understand their choices, and feel confident using what we create.

Tell me what’s on your mind ↗

04 / HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

Listen closely.
Try together.
Keep learning.

✳
01

Listen before choosing a direction.

Sit down together. Understand the people, the work, and the real need before choosing a tool or writing code.

02

Find a useful first step.

Try a useful first version together. Combine practical guidance, AI implementation, and custom development where they make a difference.

03

Stay alongside the people using it.

Check the results with the team. Refine the software, establish sensible boundaries, and make sure people can use it confidently.

Your experience stays part of the process, from the first conversation onwards.
